# tools: add clipboard as alternative of pbcopy

Try [clipboard](https://github.com/Slackadays/clipboard), a cross-platform clipboard manager for the terminal (`cb copy`, `cb paste`, multiple clipboards, history), in place of macOS's `pbcopy`/`pbpaste`, which the dotfiles use in the `cwd` alias ([[DOT-245]]).
